thread:
pagerduty: :rotating_light: PAGER - SLO breach: /v1/generate p99 latency > 2s in us-west-2 (service: router). AlertID: PD-87912

maya: I'm on it, paging into #eng-oncall, grabbing graphs.
kevin: I see the spike on the router tail, p95 ~ 850ms -> 1.1s, p99 ~ 2.4s. Streaming stalls reported. Rolling logs:
opsbot: CPU load on router-proxy-*-gw high, connection queue length rising. Top shard: shard-42 showing 60% of in-flight requests.
sarah: Could be hot-partition from routing policy change rolled 03:10 UTC. I rolled back weight tweak in staging earlier.
maya: Any recent routing policy deploys? @kevin did we push the new weight-decay policy at 03:08?
kevin: yes, rollout at 03:07, config id cfg-2023-weight-decay, 10% traffic to backup. Looks like hash bucketing shifted.
dmitri: Observed region-skew: us-west-2 is getting extra sticky keys from session affinity. KV cache evictions increased.
maya: Start mitigation: 1) Disable weight-decay policy to restore previous hashing 2) Drain shard-42 3) Route streaming traffic to dedicated pool (dedicated-ephemeral-1)
kevin: Running command:
```
redwoodctl routing update-policy --id cfg-2023-weight-decay --state disabled --dry-run=false
```
kevin: Pushing now.
opsbot: change accepted, policy cfg-2023-weight-decay state -> disabled (commit r=ad3f)
maya: Adding emergency route:
```
redwoodctl route add --from /v1/generate --to pool:dedicated-ephemeral-1 --percent 20 --reason "emergency tail mitigation"
```
sarah: 20% shift in progress.
opsbot: route assignment completed, new split: default 80%, dedicated-ephemeral-1 20%
kevin: Starting drain for shard-42:
```
redwoodctl shard drain --shard shard-42 --grace 120
```
maya: Monitoring metrics...
ok, p95 dropping to 600ms, p99 down to 1.3s :thumbsup: 
pagerduty: Update: Incident acknowledged by maya
sarah: Streaming stall logs show `stalled_read` on some connections; turning off long-stream optimization for now.
dmitri: KV cache hitrate back up after weight disable.
maya: Customer impact: several production customers in us-west-2 saw retries and ephemeral stalls, estimated affected requests ~0.4% of total. No data loss.
kevin: Raising mitigation to 40% if p99 doesn't improve in 5m.
opsbot: metrics: p99=1.3s, p95=580ms, error rate unchanged.
maya: 5m check - still p99 ~1.25s. Increase emergency route to 40%.
kevin: Updating route split.
opsbot: route update committed: dedicated-ephemeral-1 40%
maya: p99 -> 930ms, p95 -> 420ms, streaming stalls reduced.
pagerduty: Incident status: mitigated, on-call continuing investigation. Escalation: optional.
sarah: I'll open a post-incident ticket to trace the config rollout interactions and hashing edge-case; assign to routing-team.
dmitri: Suggest add canary checks for hot-key redistribution and KV eviction thresholds.
maya: Handoff to night oncall @dmitri in 30m. Summary: root cause likely routing policy rollout + hash skew causing hot partition -> overloaded shard -> tail latency. Mitigations applied: disabled policy, emergency routing to dedicated pool (40%), drained shard-42, turned off long-stream opt. Customer impact: minor tail spikes and retries for ~0.4% requests. Next steps: postmortem, add canary checks, revert emergency route once stable.
dmitri: Acknowledged, will follow up and open ticket R-2023-115.
kevin: :thumbsup: Good job team.
maya: Closing pager, tagging postmortem template.
opsbot: Pager closed by maya at 2023-11-09T03:25:00Z
sarah: assigning routing-team, cc infra and sres.
maya: Thanks all :heart:
